outcome: needs and expectations of hospital-based health professionals for an mHealth app
perceived importance of app content and features
cohort: The study surveyed 145 hospital-based health professionals from obstetrics/gynecology, nursery/neonatology, and pediatrics.
finding: Hospital-based health professionals generally recognized the value of the proposed mHealth app to support the first 1000 days of life, with varying levels of demand for content and technical features identified across three clusters.
